lines.en: I creep along the leaf veins.
Six legs grip the branch.
Step by step I near my prey.
Leaves whisper under my feet.
I keep my body very low.
Cherry petals land on my back.
I edge sideways toward the twig's tip.
My thin legs hook the rough bark.
I pause on the leaf's underside, then inch on.
I pass a sleeping insect.
Dew wets my antennae.

lines.zh: 我的影子在叶子上很小。
lines.en: My shadow is tiny on the leaf.
I tilt my head and look below.
The jungle breeze makes me sway.
I climb down the vine.
I follow the leaf vein, one step, one pause.
I raise my forelegs as if in prayer.

lines.zh: 丛林里贴着叶背，谁都没发现。
lines.en: Flat on a leaf in the jungle, unnoticed.
My compound eyes sweep the surroundings.
I work my mandibles.
This cherry grove is safe.
I make myself into a leaf.
I slowly smooth my wings.
I listen to cicadas far away.

lines.zh: 我把前足擦干净，继续等。
lines.en: I clean my forelegs and keep waiting.
I wait for a careless meal.

lines.zh: 我抖抖触角，感到空气在动。
lines.en: I twitch my antennae and feel the air move.
Sunlight filters onto me.

lines.zh: 丛林里，我的前足一直举着。
lines.en: In the jungle, my forelegs stay raised.
I'm faster than your hand.

lines.zh: 你遮住叶缝，我看不清猎物。
lines.en: You block the leaf gap, and I lose sight of my prey.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，复眼映出你的脸。
lines.en: I tilt my head; my compound eyes mirror your face.
You smell of insects.

lines.zh: 我举着前肢，像一片枯叶。
lines.en: Forelegs raised, I look like a dead leaf.
Your fingers are too thick.
I tilt my head, watching back.
This leaf is mine.

lines.zh: 我举起前足，像一根枯枝。
lines.en: I raise my forelegs like a dead twig.

lines.zh: 我的薄翅折了，只好爬行。
lines.en: My thin wing folded; I must crawl now.
I lost two legs.
My wings crumpled; I shrink behind a leaf.

lines.zh: 别捏我，我这片壳一碰就碎。
lines.en: Do not squeeze me; this shell crumbles at a touch.
I spring to the leaf's underside.
I can't last long with this.
Half an antenna snapped off.
Crawling is hard now.

lines.zh: 前足收着，樱花影里等你。
lines.en: Forelegs folded, I wait in cherry shade.
I retreat and hide.
Is that an insect?
Bring it closer, I can't see.
My mandibles are twitching.
You're holding up a leaf.
This doesn't smell like prey.
Put it down, I'll take it myself.
I'd rather eat something alive.
Your gesture is far too obvious.
That scent has hooked me.
Half an inch closer is all.
You touched my wing.
The bump tipped me onto my side.
Don't swat me.

lines.zh: 我的腿缠上了你的袖口。
lines.en: My legs snag your cuff.
One bump and I withdraw.
I crawled onto your hand, sorry.
One push and the leaf bends.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的鞋边过去了。
lines.en: I slip past the edge of your boot.
I lift myself to let you by.
Back up, I'm about to leap.
My forelegs stay raised.
First I need a good leaf.
Such things are done up high.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣，该有同样的镰臂。
lines.en: My mate should carry the same scythe arms.
I don't want to be disturbed.
My mate must be able to fly.
Wait, something is moving.
I care more about the next meal.
Don't come close, I'll flee.
Quiet, don't startle the grove.
This meat is mine.
I lift it with my forelegs.
A dropped bug, perfect.
Enough for one meal.
I take a bite, not bad.
What falls isn't fresh.
I drag it behind a leaf.
Did anyone see?
This smells of the jungle.
Stow it, eat it slowly.
You're in my range now.
I saw you move.

lines.zh: 三片叶子的距离，够我扑。
lines.en: Three leaves away—close enough to pounce.
I lift my forelegs first.
Don't run, I'm quick.
The ankle is the best place to start.

lines.zh: 你踩碎的那片叶子，很响。
lines.en: That leaf you crushed was loud.
I'm ready to leap.
You're my target.
Closer, a little closer.
My antennae point at you.

lines.zh: 你踩断树枝，暴露了位置。
lines.en: You snapped a twig and gave away your position.
I've measured my launch point.
In the leaf shade you can't see me.
Your hands are raised too high.
One strike is all.

lines.zh: 我停在樱枝上，等你先动。
lines.en: I perch on the cherry branch, waiting for you to move.
You turned the wrong way.
My forelegs are spread.
One more step into my circle.

lines.zh: 我贴在你背后的叶子上。
lines.en: I cling to the leaf behind you.

lines.zh: 你听见极轻的摩擦声吗？
lines.en: Do you hear that faint rasp?

lines.zh: 我一直在你视线的边缘。
lines.en: I'm always at the edge of your sight.
Now.
My forelegs clamp your finger.
I leap in from the side.
That only broke the skin.
I bit the back of your hand.
I'm light, so I land fast.

lines.zh: 我的镰刀前足已经扣住你。
lines.en: My scythe forelegs have already hooked you.
I withdraw and hide again.

lines.zh: 这一咬是我的全部力气。
lines.en: That bite was all my strength.
Your blood tastes of salt.
I land and look up again.
One flip of the leaf, and out I come.
A cherry blossom trembles.
I spread my forelegs and take my place.
The jungle green has gained me.

lines.zh: 我挂在叶柄上，等壳变硬。
lines.en: I hang from a leaf stalk while my shell hardens.
The leaf bends under me.
Sunlight finds my compound eyes.
I stretch my six legs.
A leaf stirs, that's me.
I settle on a slender twig.
Flame curled my wings.
I fall from the branch and flip over.
Water gums my limbs together.
The blast flings me far.

lines.zh: 丛林里，我的前足已经举起。
lines.en: In the jungle, my forelegs are raised.
A flash of light blinds all my eyes.
Too hungry to move my legs.

lines.zh: 雷落到树上，我全身一颤。
lines.en: Lightning hits the tree, my whole body jerks.
No leaf to grip in the void.
